title: The Concert We Almost Missed
sentences: We had bought the tickets four months in advance.
On the day itself, our train was cancelled without any warning, and no one explained why.
The next one would have arrived an hour after the concert began.
My sister suggested that we drive instead, which neither of us wanted to do.
We reached the hall just as the first piece was finishing.
An usher made us wait outside the doors until it had ended.
We heard the whole of it from the corridor, which was oddly beautiful in its own way.
When we finally sat down, I was still out of breath.
The second half was worth every part of the journey.
We have agreed to leave much earlier next time.
